column1: # Ash Jenna's optional first sighting in Lamakan, before the Manticore.

column3: You stopped when you saw\nme. Were you expecting\nsomeone else?{end_wait}

You were ready to follow
me. I could see it.{page_break}People are easy to lead
when they're afraid
to lose someone.{end_wait}
Keep looking for her.\nPerhaps you'll make it\nbefore it's too late.{end_wait}
She has Jenna's face.\nBut she enjoyed\nfrightening me.{end_wait}
